Hirsutism (p.2089) is frequently treated with anti- androgens, usually cyproterone or spironolactone. Spironolac- tone in doses of 50 to 200 mg daily has produced both subjective and objective improvement in hirsutism in patients with idio- pathic hirsutism or polycystic ovary syndrome,1-4 and its use has been reviewed.5 It is preferably used with oral contraceptives,6,7 to improve efficacy and menstrual irregularity and to avoid the risk of feminisation to a male fetus.
